title: Wolf and Crown
premise: Paloma Voss, exiled storm-caller and ledger-keeper for the Guild of Impossible Things, has spent nine years hiding her gift among smuggled relics and unnameable debts. When the crown's witch-hunt reaches the guildhall, she discovers the ledgers themselves are keyed to dragon-fire—and that her bloodline is the last living key. Hunted by Inquisitor Serane and sheltered by a disgraced dragon-heir named Kael, Paloma must choose between burning the ledgers (and every memory they hold) or unlocking them to reignite an ancient war that could save the gifted from extinction. She chooses memory over safety, releasing the dragons at terrible cost: her own gift, surrendered to the flame.
about_author: B. M. Zhou is the pen name of a former archivist who spent a decade cataloguing confiscated heirlooms before turning to fiction. They write about people who keep dangerous records, and live quietly with too many notebooks.

chapters.title: The Weight of Small Debts
chapters.summary: Paloma balances the guild's impossible ledgers while hiding a storm brewing under her skin. A routine delivery brings news of the crown's edict: all storm-callers to be registered or burned. POV Paloma. Emotional beat: the fragile comfort of routine cracking open.

chapters.title: What the Ledgers Remember
chapters.summary: Auditing a vault of confiscated relics, Paloma finds pages written in her grandmother's hand—entries only a Voss could have made. The ledgers respond to her touch with static and half-formed memories. POV Paloma. Emotional beat: dread curdling into forbidden curiosity.

chapters.title: Ash on the Doorstep
chapters.summary: Inquisitor Serane arrives at the guildhall demanding inspection. Paloma hides the anomalous pages inside a shipment of cursed mirrors while her employer, Master Quill, lies badly for her sake. POV Paloma. Emotional beat: terror sharpened into competence; first taste of complicity.

chapters.title: The Heir in the Cellar
chapters.summary: Following the ledgers' pull, Paloma discovers Kael—a dragon-heir kept as living collateral by the guild for thirty years. He recognizes her bloodline instantly. POV Kael. Emotional beat: two prisoners recognizing each other across different cages.

chapters.title: A Market of Impossible Things
chapters.summary: Paloma brokers a black-market deal for passage out of the city, trading secrets she shouldn't have. Serane's agents shadow her through the stalls. She learns the crown already knows about the ledgers. POV Paloma. Emotional beat: the illusion of escape collapsing into inevitability.

chapters.title: Grandmother's Storm
chapters.summary: Kael teaches Paloma to read the ledger-pages properly; each entry floods her with inherited memories of the last dragon war—including her grandmother's role in ending it by caging the fire. POV Paloma, interleaved with memory-chapters. Emotional beat: grief for an ancestor she never met, rage at what was buried.

chapters.title: The Price of Staying Invisible
chapters.summary: Serane raids the guildhall. Master Quill dies protecting the vault; Paloma unleashes a storm to cover their escape, exposing herself fully. Kael is captured buying them time. POV Paloma. Emotional beat: survival purchased with everything she was trying to protect.

chapters.title: Crown of Cinders
chapters.summary: Paloma trades herself to Serane for Kael's life, then learns the truth: the queen hunts the gifted because the royal line is dying without dragon-fire to sustain it. The hunt was always a harvest. POV Serane. Emotional beat: the hunter revealed as another instrument, hollowed by duty.

chapters.title: The Last Guttering Flame
chapters.summary: In the palace vault, Paloma opens the final ledger with her blood. Every caged memory ignites at once—the ancient war reborn as dragons wake beneath the capital. To aim the fire away from the city, she feeds the flame her own gift. POV Paloma. Emotional beat: climax; sacrifice chosen freely, finally hers.

chapters.title: Ledger of What Remains
chapters.summary: Months later, the gifted live openly under a negotiated truce; the dragons circle distant peaks. Powerless but alive, Paloma reopens the guild with Kael, writing new entries in her own hand. POV Paloma. Emotional beat: quiet resolution—inheritance transformed from burden into choice.
